rows.policy_summary: Off-topic: laboratory A1AT testing reimbursement policy, not an inpatient DRG payment rule.
Reimburses hepatic fibrosis testing for specified liver diseases semiannually; excludes separate payment for certain assays.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hepatic Fibrosis Testing for Chronic Liver Disease Policy, Professional and Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Serum hepatic fibrosis testing is reimbursable only for listed liver disease diagnoses and only within the stated six-month frequency limit.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Laboratory - Testing for Alpha1 Anti-trypsin Deficiency
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Off-topic for this DRG; the policy is a laboratory testing reimbursement rule and does not adjudicate inpatient DRG payment. It does note liver disease as a qualifying indication for A1AT testing, but no DRG-specific rule is stated.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: MEDADV Hepatic Fibrosis Testing Chronic Liver Disease Policy
reimbursement_policies.evidence: Covered with conditions for hepatic fibrosis testing in specified chronic liver disease diagnoses, limited to once every six months.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle duplicate claims for 81517, 81596, 0002M, 0003M, 0166U, 0344U, and 0468U when billed for the same member in the same billing period, and for Medicare Advantage when the same member has the test from any provider or facility on the same date of service.

IA — Implement a semiannual frequency limit for 81517, 81596, 0002M, 0003M, 0166U, 0344U, and 0468U: allow 1 unit every 180 days for the same member in Commercial and Individual Exchange, and once every six months / one unit every 180 calendar days in Medicare Advantage.
